country: multi-country (six external fundus datasets; HMADR_Clinic clinic dataset)
models_evaluated: Diabetic retinopathy screening deep learning models (incrementally developed and updated)

links.outcome: Robustness of DR predictions to acquisition noise and device-induced variability (Cohen's kappa)
links.effect: Robustness generally acceptable (kappa 0.431–0.852) but reduced in borderline cases (kappa −0.027–0.331).
links.quote: Although robustness was generally acceptable (Cohen's kappa; 0.431–0.852), it was reduced in borderline cases (Cohen's kappa; −0.027–0.331).

links.outcome: Probability calibration of DR models on external datasets (Expected Calibration Error)
links.effect: Despite median AUROC 0.974 (0.904–0.993), calibration was poor (ECE 0.031–0.133).
links.quote: Model calibration was poor (Expected Calibration Error; 0.031–0.133), and estimated uncertainty did not align with clinicians' assessments (Pearson's r ; 0.156–0.548).

links.outcome: Decision consistency and threshold stability across model updates
links.effect: Updates introduced decision instability in borderline cases (kappa 0.060–0.910) and Youden-optimal threshold fluctuations across external datasets (0.107–0.799).
links.quote: Notably, model updates also introduced decision instability in borderline cases (Cohen's kappa; 0.060–0.910) and substantial fluctuations in the Youden-optimal threshold across external datasets (0.107–0.799).

links.outcome: Alignment of model uncertainty estimates with clinician assessments
links.effect: Estimated uncertainty did not align well with clinicians' assessments (Pearson's r 0.156–0.548).
links.quote: Model calibration was poor (Expected Calibration Error; 0.031–0.133), and estimated uncertainty did not align with clinicians' assessments (Pearson's r ; 0.156–0.548).

links.outcome: Performance and threshold variation across six external sites/devices
links.effect: Youden-optimal thresholds varied widely across external datasets (0.107–0.799); AUROC ranged 0.904–0.993 across datasets.
links.quote: Notably, model updates also introduced decision instability in borderline cases (Cohen's kappa; 0.060–0.910) and substantial fluctuations in the Youden-optimal threshold across external datasets (0.107–0.799).

screen.reason: Evaluates AI models across realistic deployment and update scenarios examining reliability dimensions including calibration, uncertainty estimation, robustness to device noise, and consistency across model updates.
